Eligibility
Those eligible to purchase from the Apple Store and receive Education Pricing include faculty, staff, students and parents as follows:

Higher Education - Faculty and staff of Higher Education institutions in the United States or Puerto Rico; and students attending, or accepted into a Higher Education institution in the United States or Puerto Rico are eligible to purchase.

Higher Education Parents - Parents purchasing on behalf of their child, who is a student currently attending or accepted into a public or private Higher Education Institution in the United States or Puerto Rico, are eligible to purchase.
Purchases from the Apple Store with Education Pricing are not for institutional purchase or resale.
